# dsh-desktop-autostart-win

Windows sign-in autostart for the **DeepSeek Harness desktop app**. The plugin
adds one page to Sett
ings — **Startup / 开机自启** — with a single switch.
| Switch | Effect |
| On | Writes `DeepSeek Harness` = `"<desktop app>.exe"` under `HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\Curr
entVersion\Run`, and clears a previous "disabled" decision from Task Manager, so Windows launches th

e app after you sign in. |
| Off | Deletes that value, so the app no longer starts by itself. |

Nothing is duplicated in the plugin config: the startup entry is the only stored
state, so the page
always reports what Windows will actually run.
## Install

Requires **DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 or newer** (0.2.x) and **Windows 10/11**. Replace
`desktop` with the profi
le you actually start DSH with.
This package is distributed from GitHub; there is no npm release.

## How the app is found

The plugin never hard-codes an install path. It tries these sources in order
and stops at the first
existing executable:
| Source | What it reads |

| Running desktop app | `process.execPath` when the Host is the desktop app itself |
| App Paths | `

App Paths\DeepSeek Harness.exe` under HKCU and HKLM, 64- and 32-bit views |
| Install folders | `%LO

CALAPPDATA%\Programs`, `%ProgramFiles%`, `%ProgramFiles(x86)%` + the usual product folder names |
|
Installer records | `DisplayIcon`, `InstallLocation`, `UninstallString` in the HKCU/HKLM uninstall k
ller records | `DisplayIcon`, `InstallLocation`, `UninstallString` in the HKCU/HKLM uninstall keys |

Only a real `.exe` is accepted, and `node.exe`, `electron.exe` and uninstallers
are rejected. The Se

ttings page shows which source matched, so you can tell why
a path was chosen. A miss is retried on

the next page load (the result is cached
for one minute).

This means the switch still works from a plain `dsh` CLI session: the desktop
app is found from the
registry even though the CLI itself is `node.exe`.
## The startup entry

Windows has two places that decide whether a startup entry runs: the `Run` key
and Task Manager's ap

proval record. The plugin writes the first and clears the
second, so an entry that was disabled in *

*Task Manager → Startup** comes back
when you turn the switch on. If the entry exists but is still d

isabled, the page
says so instead of pretending it is on.

Administrator rights are not required: everything is per-user (`HKCU`) and
nothing is written machin

trator rights are not required: everything is per-user (`HKCU`) and
nothing is written machine-wide.
## Permissions and privacy
Reads, only to find the app and report state:

- `HKCU\...\CurrentVersion\Run` and `...\Explorer\StartupApproved\Run`
- `App Paths` under HKCU/HKLM

(64- and 32-bit views)
- Uninstall records under HKCU/HKLM (only the display name, icon, install
fo
lder, and uninstall command)
Writes, only when you use the switch:

- adds or deletes the `DeepSeek Harness` value in the per-user `Run` key
- deletes the matching `Sta
rtupApproved` value so Windows does not skip it

The plugin makes **no network requests**, writes **no files**, and collects
**no telemetry**. The de

tected path and registry values are returned only to the
local Settings page (the routes reject non-

loopback peers and are read-only
except for the one boolean switch).

approval record decodin

g, and the executable-name filter. They do not touch the
real registry.
## Compatibility

- DSH `>=0.2.2-rc.1 <0.3.0` (declared in `engines.dsh`; DSH refuses versions
outside the range befor

e installing)
- Windows 10/11 (`dsh.bundle.platforms` is `["win32"]`, so other systems are
rejected

instead of showing a dead switch)
- Node.js 22+ (the runtime bundled with DSH)
## Plugin index

This repository also publishes a format-1 plugin index, so the package can be
discovered from the bu
ilt-in **Discover** tab:

- jsDelivr (recommended; works on networks where `raw.githubusercontent.com`
is blocked): `https://c

dn.jsdelivr.net/gh/nanwu98/dsh-desktop-autostart-win@main/index.json`
- raw GitHub: `https://raw.git
hubusercontent.com/nanwu98/dsh-desktop-autostart-win/main/index.json`

Add it under **插件 → 发现 → 索引源 → 添加索引源**. The Discover tab needs the
experimental `plugin-market` bund
le enabled in this DSH release.
## License

MIT. This package is independent of other plugins with a similar name; it
manages the per-user `Run`
key rather than the Startup folder.
